entries.0b62ea39d3f60fdb: This segment develops, manufactures and sells electronic components, motors, FA devices and electronic materials. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, demand grew for capacitors for information and communications infrastructure and terminals, such as those for generative AI servers, industrial motors for factory labor-saving in China, and multilayer board materials for information and communications infrastructure, and revenue including intersegment transactions was ¥1,167,268 million.

entries.2b9aea9ffbdb26b6: This segment develops, manufactures and sells in-flight entertainment and communication services for aircraft, electronic component mounting systems, welding machines, projectors, personal computers and tablets, and supply chain management software (SCM). The main consolidated subsidiaries are Panasonic Connect Co., Ltd., Panasonic Avionics Corporation, which provides in-flight entertainment and communication systems, and Blue Yonder Holding, Inc., which provides SCM software. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,380,312 million including intersegment transactions, the largest amount among the six reportable segments.

entries.4013bde43e462588: This segment develops, manufactures and sells cylindrical lithium-ion batteries for automotive use, primary batteries (dry cell batteries and micro batteries), and small secondary batteries (single cells and their system products). The main consolidated subsidiaries are Panasonic Energy Co., Ltd. and Panasonic Energy North America, Inc. in Kansas, USA. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales of energy storage systems for data centers grew, driven by the growth of the generative AI market, and revenue including intersegment transactions was ¥984,245 million.
